decisive_spans.text: Demonstrates severe disorganization of the retinal architecture, subretinal fluid
Shows delayed choroidal filling, delayed retinal arterial filling, patchy temporal hyperfluorescence, diffuse leakage and poor vascular perfusion in various phases

response.rationale: The patient's presentation with sudden vision loss, relative afferent pupillary defect, tortuous vessels, serous retinal detachment, macular whitening, and evidence of retinal ischemia on imaging (delayed choroidal and retinal arterial filling, poor vascular perfusion) strongly supports Central Retinal Artery Occlusion. While Compressive optic neuropathy is also supported by some findings, the specific retinal and vascular imaging findings are more indicative of CRAO.
